lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਭ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kai madh sabh hoo te baahar raag dokh te niaaro ||
lines.translation: He is inside all, and outside of all; He is untouched by love or hate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas gobi(n)d saranaaee har preetam manahi sadhaaro ||3||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe; the Beloved Lord is the Support of the mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai khojat khojat jee har nihachal s ghar paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I searched and searched, and found the immovable, unchanging home of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਧ੍ਰੁਵ ਡਿਠੇ ਜੀਉ ਤਾ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh adhruv dithe jeeu taa charan kamal chit laaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have seen that everything is transitory and perishable, and so I have linked my consciousness to the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh abinaasee hau tis kee daasee marai na aavai jaae ||
lines.translation: God is eternal and unchanging, and I am just His hand-maiden; He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਅਰਥ ਕਾਮ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam arath kaam sabh pooran man chi(n)dee ichh pujaae ||
lines.translation: He is overflowing with Dharmic faith, wealth and success; He fulfills the desires of the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: srut simrit gun gaavahi karate sidh saadhik mun jan dhiaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Vedas and the Simritees sing the Praises of the Creator, while the Siddhas, seekers and silent sages meditate on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran kripaa nidh suaamee vadabhaagee har har gaaiaa ||4||1||11||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master, the treasure of mercy; by great good fortune, he sings the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰ ਸੂਹੀ ਕੀ ਸਲੋਕਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaar soohee kee salokaa naal mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Vaar Of Soohee, With Saloks Of The Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਪਰ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohai ves dohaaganee par pir raavan jaai ||
lines.translation: In her red robes, the discarded bride goes out, seeking enjoyment with another's husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir chhodiaa ghar aapanai mohee doojai bhaai ||
lines.translation: She leaves the husband of her own home, enticed by her love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਖਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਦਹੁ ਵਧਿਆ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithaa kar kai khaaiaa bahu saadahu vadhiaa rog ||
lines.translation: She finds it sweet, and eats it up; her excessive sensuality only makes her disease worse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਧੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sudh bhataar har chhodiaa phir lagaa jaai vijog ||
lines.translation: She forsakes the Lord, her sublime Husband, and then later, she suffers the pain of separation from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਪਲਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai s palatiaa har raatee saaj seegaar ||
lines.translation: But she who becomes Gurmukh, turns away from corruption and adorns herself, attuned to the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj sach pir raaviaa har naamaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: She enjoys her celestial Husband Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within her heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aagiaakaaree sadaa souhaagan aap melee karataar ||
lines.translation: She is humble and obedient; she is His virtuous bride forever; the Creator unites her with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak pir paaiaa har saachaa sadaa souhaagan naar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, she who has obtained the True Lord as her husband, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਵੀਏ ਨਿਮਾਣੀਏ ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohaveee nimaaneee so sahu sadaa samhaal ||
lines.translation: O meek, red-robed bride, keep your Husband Lord always in your thoughts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਛੁਟੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak janam savaarahi aapanaa kul bhee chhutee naal ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, your life shall be embellished, and your generations shall be saved along with you. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape takhat rachaaion aakaas pataalaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself established His throne, in the Akaashic ethers and the nether worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਸਾਜੀਅਨੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame dharatee saajeean sachee dharamasaalaa ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of His Command, He created the earth, the true home of Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaai khapaaidaa sache deen daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself created and destroys; He is the True Lord, merciful to the meek.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa rijak sa(n)baahidaa teraa hukam niraalaa ||
lines.translation: You give sustenance to all; how wonderful and unique is the Hukam of Your Command!

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape aap varatadaa aape pratipaalaa ||1||
lines.translation: You Yourself are permeating and pervading; You Yourself are the Cherisher. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹਬ ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohab taa sohaaganee jaa ma(n)n laihi sach naau ||
lines.translation: The red-robed woman becomes a happy soul-bride, only when she accepts the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣਾ ਮਨਾਇ ਲੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਚੜੀ ਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur apanaa manaai lai roop chaRee taa agalaa doojaa naahee thaau ||
lines.translation: Become pleasing to your True Guru, and you shall be totally beautified; otherwise, there is no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਤੂ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa seegaar banaai too mailaa kade na hovaee ahinis laagai bhaau ||
lines.translation: So decorate yourself with the decorations that will never stain, and love the Lord day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sohaagan kaa kiaa chihan hai a(n)dar sach mukh ujalaa khasamai maahi samaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, what is the character of the happy soul-bride? Within her, is Truth; her face is bright and radiant, and she is absorbed in her Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਵੇ ਹਉ ਸੂਹਵੀ ਸੂਹਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lokaa ve hau soohavee soohaa ves karee ||
lines.translation: O people: I am in red, dressed in a red robe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਰਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vesee sahu na paaeeai kar kar ves rahee ||
lines.translation: But my Husband Lord is not obtained by any robes; I have tried and tried, and given up wearing robes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tinee sahu paaiaa jinee gur kee sikh sunee ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they alone obtain their Husband Lord, who listen to the Guru's Teachings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so theeai in bidh ka(n)t milee ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever pleases Him, happens. In this way, the Husband Lord is met. ||2||
